originalRecords.title: Native staging selector reads only the selected role and preserves current-role no-op
originalRecords.purpose: Prevent the shared staging checker from misreporting authenticated multi-role accounts as failed logins when the deployed version still uses the native selector. Preserve validation of the new styled control.
originalRecords.preconditions: Native browser SELECT with Event Organiser first and Event Coordinator selected second; a real change-event counter begins at zero.
steps: Read current and held roles; request the current role while Profile holds focus; choose Organiser, then Coordinator.
originalRecords.expected: Only the selected role is reported; both held labels are returned; no-op preserves focus and dispatches zero changes; two actual selections dispatch exactly two changes.
originalRecords.layer: Playwright browser DOM and production application + local fixture API
originalRecords.actual: Focused Chromium regression: 4/4 new cases passed in 5.4s; no mocked locator objects.
originalRecords.execution_evidence: 26 Oct 2026; PR #117 follow-up on base 62687de. Focused log /tmp/sg2-96-acting-role-control-focused.log. Full browser and hosted staging reruns are recorded separately in the PR.
